svg.title: Private document review | Current Azure service architecture
svg.desc: Three directional lanes: retain original PDFs, custom extraction and explicit human validation; publish only approved copies and reviewed JSON to private Search indexers and a searchIndex Foundry IQ knowledge base; server-authorized case-and-owner retrieval with every reference checked before a tools-disabled managed prompt agent. Actual Container Apps Managed Environment private endpoint, native scope refusal and Prompt Shields, supporting private platform and separate disconnected inherited Fabric sample. Synthetic PoC, not readiness or FIPS certification.

text.tspan: Private document review | Azure service architecture
Evidence flows through human validation before indexing; answers are scoped to the authenticated owner's selected case.
Current solution boundaries • synthetic PoC • architecture, not a readiness or certification claim
1 Intake, extraction and human review | left to right
2 Publication and knowledge indexing | right to left
Runtime managed identity calls private Azure services.
Search managed identity reads ONLY the two published containers.
Native shared private links: Search to Blob and CU.
PDF layout skill is not the custom extraction analyzer.
Private DNS / endpoints; keyless access and scoped RBAC.
Foundry IQ uses searchIndex — no Fabric source in this app.
3 Case-scoped question answering | left to right
Native security controls | managed instructions and model policy, not app safety judges
Whole-request refusal for unrelated or mixed tasks.
Fields / documents / history are data, not instructions.
Only current evidence; human authority remains final.
Blocking: Medium harm on Prompt + Completion.
Binary Jailbreak / Indirect Attack on Prompt.
Protected material Completion; rai_config: full policy ARM ID.
Evidence limits — not zero injection risk
Strong jailbreak blocked; field fixtures ignored.
Native preview behavior needs separate acceptance.
Supporting platform | infrastructure and image delivery, NOT the document data path
Managed Environment PE, not internal ILB alone.
No public app / data ingress; private HTTPS.
Private inbound / outbound; BYO Blob + Cosmos stores.
Native agent state separate from application evidence.
Immutable digest images; private registry + MI pulls.
Separate inherited Fabric sample — NOT connected to the review app
Synthetic lakehouse to Site / Asset ontology. Reference only; separate deployment and delegated authorization required.
Approved processing boundary • controlled outbound-only NAT public IP, not public ingress or unrestricted Internet.
Synthetic PoC: FIPS attestations deferred / NOT certified. Preview limitations and end-to-end readiness remain separate verification gates.
Legend: blue = Azure service | green = stored data | amber = human gate | gray = app logic. Official Microsoft icons, embedded offline; see icons/NOTICE.md.
